map.OEE 综合设备效率 使用指南: OEE Overall Equipment Effectiveness User Guide
map.输入可用率、性能率与合格率，按 OEE=可用率×性能率×合格率计算综合设备效率(: Enter availability, performance and quality rates and compute OEE = availability x performance x quality (world class 85% or above), locating the loss points on the line.
map.设备效率改善项目启动时，用 OEE 量化可用率、性能率、合格率三大损失，定位最大: When launching an equipment efficiency improvement project, use OEE to quantify the three losses - availability, performance and quality - and locate the biggest leak.
map.班前会设定 OEE 目标（世界级 ≥85%），对比各班组/产线，驱动 TPM 与: Set an OEE target at the pre-shift meeting (world class 85% or above), compare across teams and lines, and drive TPM and small-stop governance.
map.新设备验收或工艺改造前后，用 OEE 前后对比验证改善效果。: When accepting new equipment or before and after a process retrofit, compare OEE before and after to verify the improvement.
map.：某设备计划运行 480 分钟（8 小时班）、非计划停机 60 分钟、单件节拍: A machine plans to run 480 minutes (an 8-hour shift) with 60 minutes of unplanned downtime, a cycle time of 120 seconds, 200 units produced and 195 good units. Availability = (480-60)/480 = 87.5%; theoretical output = 420x60/120 = 210 units, performance = 200/210 = about 95.2%; quality = 195/200 = 97.5%; OEE = 87.5% x 95.2% x 97.5% = about 81.2% (close to the good grade). The losses come mainly from downtime (12.5%) and small speed losses.
map.OEE 三个因子哪个最该优先改善？: Which of the Three OEE Factors Should Be Improved First?
map.先看损失最大的因子。可用率损失（停机/换型）通常改善空间最大，可推 TPM；性能: Start with the factor losing the most. Availability loss (downtime and changeovers) usually has the most room for improvement, so push TPM; performance loss comes mostly from small stops and slowdowns; quality loss relies on process control. World-class OEE is 85% or above (availability 90%, performance 95%, quality 99%).
map.OEE 和产能利用率有什么区别？: What's the Difference Between OEE and Capacity Utilization?
map.产能利用率只看产出/理论产能，忽略停机、速度、质量损失；OEE 同时纳入可用率×: Capacity utilization only looks at output over theoretical capacity and ignores downtime, speed and quality losses; OEE folds in availability x performance x quality, which better reflects effective output and is a more complete efficiency indicator for manufacturing.
